name: Current Pressure in Veyr
summary: The city is tightening inspections after a customs barge vanished with sealed records aboard.
active_crises: The Office of Weights doubled inspections at Tidegate overnight.
Rumors about a missing succession record are spreading through the canal wards.
legal_pressure: All undeclared ledgers can be seized on sight.
Inspectors are encouraged to verify seals manually if the registry looks altered.
environmental_notes: Morning tide keeps the lower flood tunnels half-flooded.
A cold drizzle makes paper handling slower and more dangerous.
rumors_in_circulation: The vanished barge was carrying more than tax rolls.
Someone inside the Office changed the route before the disappearance.
